svg.title: Selecting even indices and squaring values have the same ratio but different first terms
svg.desc: The original geometric progression has first term twelve and ratio minus one half. Its first six terms are twelve, minus six, three, minus three halves, three quarters and minus three eighths. Selecting the even-indexed terms gives minus six, minus three halves, minus three eighths and so on; its first term is minus six, ratio one quarter and sum to infinity minus eight. Squaring every original term gives one hundred forty-four, thirty-six, nine, nine quarters and so on; its first term is one hundred forty-four, ratio one quarter and sum to infinity one hundred ninety-two.
